name: Owner move-in for a person who is not the owner is rejected
title: SC-08-06-02 Owner move-in for a person who is not the owner is rejected
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given Unit "B Blok D:12" is VACANT with Owner "Ahmet Yılmaz"
When an owner move-in is requested for "Mehmet Demir"
Then the request is rejected with a validation error
And the unit remains VACANT with Owner "Ahmet Yılmaz"
